steps.name: Væla
steps.text: Thank you for the hospitality.

steps.name: Gargoyle
steps.text: The pleasure is all mine. It's such a joy to see a Banshee these days.

steps.name: Væla
steps.text: Why is that?

steps.name: Gargoyle
steps.text: Makes it easier for me to ask for an elegy when me or my family reach the end of the road.

steps.name: Gargoyle
steps.text: Not much has changed with Kazdel, but few Banshees come anymore.

steps.name: Gargoyle
steps.text: Our departed kin won't find the myriad souls without your guidance.

steps.name: Væla
steps.text: I'm sorry.

steps.name: Væla
steps.text: I'll... do my best.

steps.name: Gargoyle
steps.text: Just kidding. You came to treat that 'Roosting Tree' of yours, right?

steps.name: Gargoyle
steps.text: Is this the branch?

steps.name: Væla
steps.text: Incantation analysis failed to discover the reasons behind its decay.

steps.name: Væla
steps.text: It is the pillar of the entire Banshee race. A friend recommended you as a Child of Soil and Stone familiar with plants. Please—

steps.name: Gargoyle
steps.text: Let me see what I can do. I'll get some dirt...

steps.name: Gargoyle
steps.text: Can you get a pot from the backyard? If you see any fowlbeasts stealing vegetables, just chase them away.

steps.name: Væla
steps.text: 'Disperse.'
The fowlbeasts disperse, but the decrepit vegetable garden is not quiet yet. A vegetable sprout vibrates violently in front of Væla.
Then, a black, branch-like horn emerges from the dust-covered leaves.

steps.name: Væla
steps.text: 'Fowlbeasts stealing vegetables', eh...
Get lost or I'll rip your head off!

steps.name: Væla
steps.text: You shouldn't yell like that. It's bad for your voice.

steps.name: Væla
steps.text: No need to be afraid. I would not hurt a child.
The young Banshee peeks out from behind the leaves, hiding a half-eaten piece of vegetable leaf behind her back.

steps.name: Young Banshee
steps.text: Don't you dare take my food.

steps.name: Væla
steps.text: If it's 'your' food...

steps.name: Young Banshee
steps.text: What's that in your hand?
Before Væla can react, the young Banshee has snatched the Roosting Tree branch from her hand, and begins trying to eat it.

steps.name: Young Banshee
steps.text: Pfft. Just a stupid branch that's been lying in the mud. It stinks.

steps.name: Væla
steps.text: Are you hungry? Let me see... I made some pastries from the dew-caps that grow along the shore of Mist Lake. It's the right season for them.

steps.name: Young Banshee
steps.text: Hmph! Safer to scrounge food off the dead. Get away from me!

steps.name: Young Banshee
steps.text: (Menacing howl)

steps.name: Young Banshee
steps.text: You're not scared? Even those big mercs are scared of that sound.

steps.name: Væla
steps.text: That is the sound of the Banshees. Of our clan.

steps.name: Væla
steps.text: I have not heard this note in the song of the Banshees for a long time. Years ago, the last one who sang it...

steps.name: Væla
steps.text: You are that child...

steps.name: Young Banshee
steps.text: You know who taught me the sound?

steps.name: Young Banshee
steps.text: But I've never met you before.

steps.name: Væla
steps.text: We don't come to Kazdel much these days. Our home is in a distant valley, a place where trees grow, with fruit hanging from their branches.

steps.name: Young Banshee
steps.text: It's hard to find food. You gotta be ready for a beating.

steps.name: Young Banshee
steps.text: But let's say the place you're talking about really exists, where fruit just grows on the trees like that... what's the catch?

steps.name: Væla
steps.text: Clever girl.

steps.name: Væla
steps.text: Maybe you should come with me. You belong there. You'll like it.

steps.name: Væla
steps.text: Even if you don't believe it exists.

steps.name: Young Banshee
steps.text: Why should I?

steps.name: Væla
steps.text: Your name is Nasti, isn't it?

steps.name: Væla
steps.text: Is that... the presence of a Banshee I sense? And... what's that? Wither... decay?

steps.name: Væla
steps.text: No... Nasti... are you...?

steps.name: Væla
steps.text: Are you trying to repeat the mistakes of the past?

steps.name: Propeller Paradise Police
steps.text: Most of the Rhine staff have evacuated the Vivarium, sir. Only Nasti and a few researchers are staying behind to organize documents. They don't look happy.

steps.name: Gordon
steps.text: Are you happy? The plan wasn't to ruin the whole Vivarium.

spans.text: happy? The plan wasn't to ruin the whole Vivarium.

steps.name: Propeller Paradise Police
steps.text: You said the tour guide knew too much about the Banshees. This was a chance to expose her and drag Nasti into it. Kill two fowlbeasts with one stone.

steps.name: Propeller Paradise Police
steps.text: It was a rough plan to begin with. Isn't the Vivarium accident a convenient excuse to stop Rhine's inspections?

steps.name: Gordon
steps.text: Convenient? And where do you think we'll find that frickin' guide?

steps.name: Propeller Paradise Police
steps.text: Uh...

steps.name: Gordon
steps.text: I know Nasti. She would never let something like this happen to the Vivarium just accidentally. Besides, there's no way she would risk Rhine's exhibit, with the exhibition right around the corner.

spans.text: I know Nasti. She would never let something like this happen to the Vivarium just
Besides, there's no way she would risk Rhine's exhibit, with the exhibition right around the corner.

steps.name: Propeller Paradise Police
steps.text: The guide... she was gone before the alarm sounded!

steps.name: Gordon
steps.text: She must have done something.

steps.name: Gordon
steps.text: It's not enough to just evacuate the researchers. There's a good chance that Nasti's already onto my plan, and is just waiting for evidence... evidence that I can't afford to give her.

steps.name: Gordon
steps.text: Tell your men to find Ferne by sundown.

steps.name: Propeller Paradise Police
steps.text: Yes, sir!

steps.name: Ferne
steps.text: Deep breaths, Ferne... maybe she just went off on her own...

steps.name: Ferne
steps.text: No, no, no, she doesn't even remember why she came to Propeller Paradise, where on Terra could she go?

steps.name: Ferne
steps.text: But if that's not what she did...
Then someone must have taken her.

steps.name: Ferne
steps.text: Who's there?!

steps.name: Mercia
steps.text: Miss.

steps.name: Ferne
steps.text: Wh-What are you doing here?

steps.name: Researcher
steps.text: What are you standing there for? Hurry up and move the saplings for the exhibition. Those are our last ones—

steps.name: Mercia
steps.text: All dead... in five minutes?
Mercia reaches out to touch the withered tree in the middle of the Vivarium. She sees a small hole at eye-level.

steps.name: Mercia
steps.text: A natural cavity... no, a connector?

steps.name: Mercia
steps.text: The withered plants. The tree hole. No equipment malfunction... tell me, what was that 'branch' attached to you, and where did it go?

steps.name: Mercia
steps.text: It was Ferne!

steps.name: Mercia
steps.text: You took that bone pen from the tree in the Vivarium, didn't you?

steps.name: Mercia
steps.text: It's plain, simple, unremarkable. You couldn't have known that it was the key that controls the entire Vivarium. It wasn't your intention to sabotage it.

steps.name: Ferne
steps.text: ...Is Mr. Tannen waiting outside with his men?

steps.name: Mercia
steps.text: I came alone, Miss. I don't think the responsibility for what happened to the Vivarium should fall on your shoulders.

steps.name: Ferne
steps.text: What do you mean?

steps.name: Mercia
steps.text: There are some things I still have to look into, but I've suspected that Mr. Tannen has been plotting against Rhine ever since he agreed to help the mysterious Banshee guest for no apparent reason. Either that, or his own private interests are involved...

steps.name: Ferne
steps.text: You suspect your own boss? But he said Columbia would do good by a good person.

steps.name: Mercia
steps.text: He also said that there's nobody easier to deal with than a good person.

steps.name: Ferne
steps.text: Then my client...

steps.name: Mercia
steps.text: There's a row of 'VIP rooms' outside Mr. Tannen's office. You could try looking there.

steps.name: Mercia
steps.text: I hope your client just went out for a walk, I truly do.

steps.name: Sky Jagger
steps.text: Gordon must be behind this!

steps.name: Sky Jagger
steps.text: Altering the list of inspections, then sabotaging the whole Vivarium and putting the Rhine exhibit on lockdown... what he gonna do next, chase us out of Propeller Paradise?

steps.name: Nasti
steps.text: There is no problem with our systems or hardware.

steps.name: Sky Jagger
steps.text: He sent someone to steal your bone pen.

steps.name: Nasti
steps.text: It's not like him.

steps.name: Sky Jagger
steps.text: Why are you trying to use logic to explain the actions of a bandit?

steps.name: Sky Jagger
steps.text: They don't operate under the same rules we do, except when they talk officialese. None of the corporations on Propeller Paradise do.

steps.name: Sky Jagger
steps.text: We're closer to the Barrier than anyone else. We're different.

steps.name: Sky Jagger
steps.text: Countless tech firms fall by the wayside, but the Business Registrar rarely gets any complaints. Why?

steps.name: Sky Jagger
steps.text: Because there is a consensus—in the Sky Age, the higher you stand, the more respect you deserve.

steps.name: Sky Jagger
steps.text: Gordon's interference with our experiments violates Propeller Paradise's consensus. He should...

steps.name: Nasti
steps.text: You don't want to be bound by the rules, but you still want to exploit them.

steps.name: Nasti
steps.text: You're proving that Rhine is not yet ready to reach those heights.

steps.name: Sky Jagger
steps.text: What...?

steps.name: Nasti
steps.text: Stop working and listen up, everybody. This is about today's incident, and how we proceed from here.

steps.name: Nasti
steps.text: Cultivation and I have confirmed that the seventy-two trees waiting to be replanted, three hundred and fifty saplings and more than one thousand ungerminated seeds, are all dead.

steps.name: Nasti
steps.text: The Propeller Paradise Police are now in charge of investigating the incident. We don't know how long that will take, but there is no realistic chance that the Vivarium can be restored before the exhibition.

steps.name: Nasti
steps.text: Senior researchers will have to stay behind and work on the incident report with me. The rest of you can enjoy a little time off. Any questions?

steps.name: Sky Jagger
steps.text: Director Lunorey. You said the Vivarium was our most important project, the cumulation of data sent back by the Ring Lab.

steps.name: Sky Jagger
steps.text: Does this mean that we failed to protect the last legacy of Galleria Stellaria?

steps.name: Nasti
steps.text: Dismissed.

steps.name: Ferne
steps.text: VIP rooms outside the office area... here we are.

steps.name: Ferne
steps.text: Mercia had suspicions, but no proof that Mr. Tannen really... never mind, the most important thing is to find the client!
...Try to run again, and I start breaking bones!

steps.name: Ferne
steps.text: There's someone inside?

steps.name: Propeller Paradise Police
steps.text: For anyone's sake, quit crying and keep quiet until the end of the exhibition!

steps.name: Propeller Paradise Police
steps.text: Ugh, my head hurts. Let me get a smoke.

steps.name: Oakley
steps.text: Please, sir, let me go... I won't say anything about Mr. Tannen...

steps.name: Ferne
steps.text: Oakley? What are you doing here? Open your eyes!

steps.name: Oakley
steps.text: The impostor...

steps.name: Ferne
steps.text: I've got a name. It's Ferne.

steps.name: Ferne
steps.text: Mr. Tannen said he was gonna treat you well and pay you compensation. What's going on...?

steps.name: Oakley
steps.text: Treat me well? He freakin' locked me up!

steps.name: Oakley
steps.text: And none of this would've happened, if you didn't impersonate me!

steps.name: Ferne
steps.text: Hey, you're the one who begged me to take your number and resume that night, tears and snot all over your face. What did you say back then? You were a 'lonely soul looking for love'—

steps.name: Oakley
steps.text: Alright, alright, stop, stop, STOP!

steps.name: Oakley
steps.text: Me and my rotten luck... it's a huge deal, letting unauthorized personnel sneak into a high-security experiment zone. That's why they wanted to shut me up.

steps.name: Oakley
steps.text: But how did YOU get out? I heard the guards say that Mr. Tannen was gonna deal with the troublemaking imposter.

steps.name: Ferne
steps.text: ...I see.

steps.name: Oakley
steps.text: Are we dead? I just wanted to see what life would be like in the future, but now it looks like I ain't got no future no more...

steps.name: Ferne
steps.text: You wanna join my tour, Real Oakley?

steps.name: Oakley
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Ferne
steps.text: I got in unnoticed, I can get you out safely.

steps.name: Oakley
steps.text: You can?

steps.name: Propeller Paradise Police
steps.text: Man alive, I went out for a smoke and a whole PERSON just grew out from the floor or what?

steps.name: Propeller Paradise Police
steps.text: You can get in, but you won't get out!

steps.name: Ferne
steps.text: Not gonna let us go in peace, huh?

steps.name: Oakley
steps.text: Y-You mean it when you say you can get me out? I'll join your tour or what ever it is, just get me outta here!

steps.name: Ferne
steps.text: Good. You won't regret it. Let me tell you about how I braved the dangers of the Bleached Wasteland—

steps.name: Oakley
steps.text: Just deal with this guy! Damn, my hands are still tied...

steps.name: Ferne
steps.text: Don't worry, a good tour guide never makes her customers do her job.

steps.name: Ferne
steps.text: Welcome to Ferne's Tours! Please be aware that you may encounter loud noises during this tour.

steps.name: Ferne
steps.text: Cover your ears, or keep your distance from me. Now, let's get moving—

steps.name: Propeller Paradise Police
steps.text: Argh...

steps.name: Ferne
steps.text: Run!

steps.name: Propeller Paradise Police
steps.text: Frickin' hell! After them! Don't let them get away!
